steps.name: 年轻客户额度规则
steps.drl:
package workbench

// 与业务系统交换的事实类型；输入字段由调用方设置，动作写回输出字段。
declare RuleInput
    customerAge : Integer
    annualIncome : Double
    creditScore : Integer
    customerType : String
    overdue : Boolean
    riskLevel : String
    reviewRequired : Boolean
    approvedLimit : Double
end

rule "年轻客户额度规则 [1]"
    salience 10
    no-loop true
when
    $input : RuleInput( customerAge < 30, annualIncome < 100000d )
then
    modify($input) {
        setApprovedLimit(50000d),
        setRiskLevel("中")
    }
end

package workbench

rule "信用评级决策表（演示） 第1行 [1]"
    salience 0
    no-loop true
when
    $input : RuleInput( creditScore >= 700, customerType in ("VIP", "whale") )
then
    modify($input) {
        setRiskLevel("低"),
        setReviewRequired(false)
    }
end

rule "信用评级决策表（演示） 第2行 [2]"
    salience 0
    no-loop true
when
    $input : RuleInput( creditScore >= 500, creditScore <= 700, customerType == "normal" )
then
    modify($input) {
        setRiskLevel("中"),
        setReviewRequired(true)
    }
end

rule "信用评级决策表（演示） 第3行 [3]"
    salience 0
    no-loop true
when
    $input : RuleInput( creditScore <= 500 )
then
    modify($input) {
        setRiskLevel("高"),
        setReviewRequired(true)
    }
end

rule "信用评级决策表（演示） 默认行 [4]"
    salience -1
    no-loop true
when
    not RuleInput( creditScore >= 700, customerType in ("VIP", "whale") )
    not RuleInput( creditScore >= 500, creditScore <= 700, customerType == "normal" )
    not RuleInput( creditScore <= 500 )
    $input : RuleInput(  )
then
    modify($input) {
        setRiskLevel("待定"),
        setReviewRequired(false)
    }
end

description: 6 条 BAL 判定规则（启动/充氮→环流/环流→保氮/保氮→补氮/补氮→环流/完成），阈值参数化进 facts，定时器由外部注入信号

steps.name: 启动充氮
steps.drl:
package workbench

// 与业务系统交换的事实类型；输入字段由调用方设置，动作写回输出字段。
declare RuleInput
    phase : String
    nitrogenPct : Double
    maxPct : Double
    minPct : Double
    startAt : String
    endAt : String
    now : String
    circulationElapsed : Boolean
    nextPhase : String
    genCmd : String
    n2vCmd : String
    cvCmd : String
    fanCmd : String
    reason : String
end

rule "启动充氮 [1]"
    salience 1
    no-loop true
when
    $input : RuleInput( phase == "DRAFT" )
then
    modify($input) {
        setNextPhase("FILLING"),
        setGenCmd("ON"),
        setN2vCmd("OPEN"),
        setCvCmd("CLOSED"),
        setFanCmd("ON"),
        setReason("开始充氮，进入充氮期")
    }
end

fields.description: 不参与规则条件，仅用于执行报告与审计留痕

fields.label: 当前阶段
fields.description: 由仓端中控持有并在每轮传入

fields.label: 环流期满
fields.description: 中控预处理：环流累计运行时长 >= 配置时长（暂停期间冻结）

fields.label: 暂停中
fields.description: 暂停标志。中控侧暂停时直接短路（不调用 RES），此字段同时作为规则侧兜底（决策记录 D3）

steps.name: 充氮状态迁移表
steps.drl:
package workbench

// 与业务系统交换的事实类型；输入字段由调用方设置，动作写回输出字段。
declare RuleInput
    warehouseId : String
    phase : String
    pctAtLeastMax : Boolean
    pctBelowMin : Boolean
    circElapsed : Boolean
    endReached : Boolean
    paused : Boolean
    nitrogenPct : Double
    maxPct : Double
    minPct : Double
    nextPhase : String
    genCmd : String
    fillValveCmd : String
    circValveCmd : String
    fanCmd : String
    reason : String
end

rule "充氮状态迁移表 第1行 [1]"
    salience 30000010
    activation-group "decision-table:e65de44d-c757-4bfb-9dd2-2862a2b43635"
    no-loop true
when
    $input : RuleInput( phase == "PENDING", paused == false )
then
    modify($input) {
        setNextPhase("FILLING"),
        setReason("开始充氮，进入充氮期"),
        setGenCmd("ON"),
        setFillValveCmd("OPEN"),
        setCircValveCmd("CLOSED"),
        setFanCmd("ON")
    }
end

rule "充氮状态迁移表 第2行 [2]"
    salience 30000009
    activation-group "decision-table:e65de44d-c757-4bfb-9dd2-2862a2b43635"
    no-loop true
when
    $input : RuleInput( phase == "FILLING", pctAtLeastMax == false, paused == false )
then
    modify($input) {
        setNextPhase("FILLING"),
        setReason("充氮未达标，保持充氮"),
        setGenCmd("ON"),
        setFillValveCmd("OPEN"),
        setCircValveCmd("CLOSED"),
        setFanCmd("ON")
    }
end

rule "充氮状态迁移表 第3行 [3]"
    salience 30000008
    activation-group "decision-table:e65de44d-c757-4bfb-9dd2-2862a2b43635"
    no-loop true
when
    $input : RuleInput( phase == "FILLING", pctAtLeastMax == true, paused == false )
then
    modify($input) {
        setNextPhase("CIRCULATION"),
        setReason("浓度达最大，停止充氮转环流"),
        setGenCmd("OFF"),
        setFillValveCmd("CLOSED"),
        setCircValveCmd("OPEN"),
        setFanCmd("ON")
    }
end

rule "充氮状态迁移表 第4行 [4]"
    salience 30000007
    activation-group "decision-table:e65de44d-c757-4bfb-9dd2-2862a2b43635"
    no-loop true
when
    $input : RuleInput( phase == "CIRCULATION", circElapsed == false, paused == false )
then
    modify($input) {
        setNextPhase("CIRCULATION"),
        setReason("环流中，通风循环"),
        setGenCmd("OFF"),
        setFillValveCmd("CLOSED"),
        setCircValveCmd("OPEN"),
        setFanCmd("ON")
    }
end

rule "充氮状态迁移表 第5行 [5]"
    salience 30000006
    activation-group "decision-table:e65de44d-c757-4bfb-9dd2-2862a2b43635"
    no-loop true
when
    $input : RuleInput( phase == "CIRCULATION", circElapsed == true, paused == false )
then
    modify($input) {
        setNextPhase("HOLDING"),
        setReason("环流期满，进入保氮期"),
        setGenCmd("OFF"),
        setFillValveCmd("CLOSED"),
        setCircValveCmd("CLOSED"),
        setFanCmd("OFF")
    }
end

rule "充氮状态迁移表 第6行 [6]"
    salience 30000005
    activation-group "decision-table:e65de44d-c757-4bfb-9dd2-2862a2b43635"
    no-loop true
when
    $input : RuleInput( phase == "HOLDING", pctBelowMin == false, paused == false )
then
    modify($input) {
        setNextPhase("HOLDING"),
        setReason("保氮中，设备全关"),
        setGenCmd("OFF"),
        setFillValveCmd("CLOSED"),
        setCircValveCmd("CLOSED"),
        setFanCmd("OFF")
    }
end

rule "充氮状态迁移表 第7行 [7]"
    salience 30000004
    activation-group "decision-table:e65de44d-c757-4bfb-9dd2-2862a2b43635"
    no-loop true
when
    $input : RuleInput( phase == "HOLDING", pctBelowMin == true, paused == false )
then
    modify($input) {
        setNextPhase("REPLENISHING"),
        setReason("浓度低于最小，开充氮补氮"),
        setGenCmd("ON"),
        setFillValveCmd("OPEN"),
        setCircValveCmd("CLOSED"),
        setFanCmd("OFF")
    }
end

rule "充氮状态迁移表 第8行 [8]"
    salience 30000003
    activation-group "decision-table:e65de44d-c757-4bfb-9dd2-2862a2b43635"
    no-loop true
when
    $input : RuleInput( phase == "REPLENISHING", pctAtLeastMax == false, paused == false )
then
    modify($input) {
        setNextPhase("REPLENISHING"),
        setReason("补氮未达标，保持补氮"),
        setGenCmd("ON"),
        setFillValveCmd("OPEN"),
        setCircValveCmd("CLOSED"),
        setFanCmd("OFF")
    }
end

rule "充氮状态迁移表 第9行 [9]"
    salience 30000002
    activation-group "decision-table:e65de44d-c757-4bfb-9dd2-2862a2b43635"
    no-loop true
when
    $input : RuleInput( phase == "REPLENISHING", pctAtLeastMax == true, paused == false )
then
    modify($input) {
        setNextPhase("CIRCULATION"),
        setReason("补氮达标，停止充氮转环流"),
        setGenCmd("OFF"),
        setFillValveCmd("CLOSED"),
        setCircValveCmd("OPEN"),
        setFanCmd("ON")
    }
end

rule "充氮状态迁移表 第10行 [10]"
    salience 30000001
    activation-group "decision-table:e65de44d-c757-4bfb-9dd2-2862a2b43635"
    no-loop true
when
    $input : RuleInput( paused == true )
then
    modify($input) {
        setNextPhase("PAUSED"),
        setReason("暂停中，设备全关"),
        setGenCmd("OFF"),
        setFillValveCmd("CLOSED"),
        setCircValveCmd("CLOSED"),
        setFanCmd("OFF")
    }
end

steps.name: 充氮结束处理表
steps.drl:
package workbench

// 与业务系统交换的事实类型；输入字段由调用方设置，动作写回输出字段。
declare RuleInput
    warehouseId : String
    phase : String
    pctAtLeastMax : Boolean
    pctBelowMin : Boolean
    circElapsed : Boolean
    endReached : Boolean
    paused : Boolean
    nitrogenPct : Double
    maxPct : Double
    minPct : Double
    nextPhase : String
    genCmd : String
    fillValveCmd : String
    circValveCmd : String
    fanCmd : String
    reason : String
end

rule "充氮结束处理表 第1行 [1]"
    salience 60000001
    activation-group "decision-table:94a34ecf-8f4c-4f2b-9909-39476b21c4fb"
    no-loop true
when
    $input : RuleInput( endReached == true )
then
    modify($input) {
        setNextPhase("COMPLETED"),
        setReason("到达结束时间，充氮结束"),
        setGenCmd("OFF"),
        setFillValveCmd("CLOSED"),
        setCircValveCmd("CLOSED"),
        setFanCmd("OFF")
    }
end
